source_identity.aggregate_diff_definition: SHA-256 of git diff --binary d9f1081..6c247bf before this evidence file was added.

change.summary: Split the exact legacy-high GF16 K=1000, R=200, 65536-byte qualified AUTO encode into two balanced 32768-byte end-to-end transform passes and reuse the same 2T work slots.

promotion_scope.required_context: AUTO on a startup-qualified AVX-512VL encode host whose reported baseline is AVX2
promotion_scope.excluded: Every other K, R, T, shard length, ragged tail, explicit backend, and uncalibrated host retains the prior single-pass layout.

change.source_policy: Each 32768-byte execution pass supplies the full aligned public length of 65536 bytes as source_policy_bytes. This preserves the pre-candidate greater-than-16-KiB copy-first crossover. The legacy overload passes buffer_bytes for both arguments.
change.scratch_contract: The public scratch query has no output-mask parameter, so every parity subset uses the same compact two-pass geometry in the promoted cell. Partial-mask AVX2 execution was therefore measured separately.

same_source_mask_screen.correctness: All 48 timed processes produced one identical input/output digest pair per mask; every reserved-sibling non-idle delta was zero. The later one-pass-preservation commit changes only the execution_tile_count==1 branch; the measured two-pass branch is byte-for-byte source-identical.

pre_narrowing_neighbor_screen.qualification: Directional only: this screen preceded the final exact dispatch narrowing, although the promoted 64-KiB cell executes the same implementation and backend semantics.

exact_leopard_main_gate.method: Three independent ABBA rounds, six constituent pairs, nine retained samples per invocation, two warmups, one thread, CPU 4 with SMT sibling 20 reserved, and a fail-closed zero-nonidle-jiffy sibling gate. The committed v6 verifier passed source, object, archive, link, runtime, workload-digest, and isolation closure. Contaminated attempts on other CPU pairs and two rejected prefix attempts were retained only as failure bundles and were not analyzed.

full_output_target.interpretation: Leopard2 remains credibly 2.32 percent slower than exact Leopard main in the target full-output encode cell. The bead's at-least-five-percent exact-main promotion gate is not met.

neighbor_codec.interpretation: This is a distinct R=199 codec and not the R=200 prefix-199 parity-mask branch; its Leopard2 scratch remains untiled. It is a neighboring nonregression observation only.

exact_leopard_main_gate.parity_subset_comparability: Exact Leopard1 always computes all R public parity shards and has no parity-subset API. The R=200 prefix-199, sparse-three, and output-zero tiling results therefore remain same-source Leopard2 comparisons and are not mislabeled as Leopard1 results.
exact_leopard_main_gate.disposition: Retain the bounded tiling as an intermediate same-source and scratch reduction while the parent GF16 exact-main optimization remains active; do not close the exact-main gap or claim that this candidate alone met its final promotion threshold.

targeted_correctness.clang_asan_ubsan_before_final_narrowing: 15/15 focused tests passed with ASan+UBSan, leak detection, halt-on-error, and OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.
targeted_correctness.final_strict_and_sanitizer_state: Post-narrowing Clang 18 strict Release and Clang 18 ASan+UBSan builds each passed all 15 focused tests. Strict flags were -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror. Sanitizers used -O1 -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fsanitize=address,undefined, ASAN leak detection and halt-on-error, UBSAN halt-on-error and stack traces, and OMP_NUM_THREADS=1.
targeted_correctness.post_independent_review_release: 8/8 focused encode, backend, API, aliasing, concurrency, and legacy-golden tests passed after the test-memory fix.
targeted_correctness.post_independent_review_asan_ubsan: 4/4 direct-encode, API, public-contract, and batch-aliasing tests passed under Clang 18 ASan+UBSan with leak detection and halt-on-error after the test-memory fix.
targeted_correctness.campaign_scope: Optimization-oriented validation by user direction: targeted parity differential tests, direct-algebra checks, dispatch/backend boundaries, alias/sentinel/concurrency tests, strict warnings, and ASan+UBSan. No broad fuzz campaign was run for this isolated optimization.
coverage: all 200 parity shards byte-for-byte against the old leo_encode API
independent direct Lagrange evaluation of a GF16 symbol
dense, 199-output prefix, and holey three-output parity masks
unrequested-output sentinels and immutable source buffers
two concurrent callers reusing one immutable codec
explicit scalar, SSSE3, AVX2, AVX512, and NEON contexts retain one pass when supported
65536+64-byte and ragged 65536+2-byte calls retain one pass

audited: scratch query and runtime geometry identity
exact calibrated-host and codec-cell dispatch gate
AUTO AVX-512 dense and AVX2 partial-output semantics
source and destination offsets, work-slot bounds, and output holes
alias rejection, failure atomicity, immutable-codec concurrency
same-source benchmark artifacts and committed evidence claims
independent_review.production_differential: Current production dense, prefix-199, sparse-three, and single-output hashes matched the frozen control. The 32768-byte, ragged 65538-byte, and neighboring 65600-byte dense and sparse checks also matched the control.

test_memory_fix.method: Hash immutable sources instead of retaining a full duplicate, move the transmitted legacy parity buffers without copying, release sequential encode results and alias scratch before concurrency, and skip the large differential when the calibrated tiling path is inactive while retaining dispatch assertions.

static_and_assembly_audit.source_audit: Public spans are validated before writes; every byte-tile offset remains within those spans; null outputs use disjoint compact work slots; codec/backend tables are immutable; each call owns its pointer array and scratch.
static_and_assembly_audit.pre_narrowing_clang_object: The separate ReedSolomonEncodeWithSourcePolicy symbol was present. The source-policy comparison compiled as cmp $0x4001 on the policy-byte argument, and legacy wrappers passed the ordinary buffer length for both byte arguments. Layout division remained in setup/outer-pass control rather than field byte loops.
static_and_assembly_audit.final_object_state: The final Clang strict object retains a distinct ReedSolomonEncodeWithSourcePolicy symbol at 0x290 and legacy ReedSolomonEncode wrappers at 0x24d0/0x2500. IFFT compares the third SysV argument against 0x4001, so the 16-KiB crossover uses full source_policy_bytes rather than the 32-KiB execution tile. Both legacy wrappers move buffer_bytes into that policy argument before calling the new symbol. EncodeLayout assembly gates tiling on K=0x3e8, R=0xc8, T=0x100, shard_bytes=0x10000, and qualified AUTO/context/backend checks before setting tile_count=2 and tile_bytes=0x8000. Division and tiling setup remain outside field byte loops.

compatibility.legacy_high_parity: Byte-identical in targeted old-API comparisons and all existing legacy golden/matrix tests run before narrowing; the final narrowing changes only whether a call enters the optimization.
compatibility.exact_leopard_main_benchmark: Performed against exact main 6e5725eb at integrated candidate 8b69b39. Every original, parity, and recovered-output digest matched, but the full-output encode ratio was 0.97678x, so the exact-main performance gap remains open.

conclusion: The bounded tile clears the same-source 5% rule for full and measured subset outputs, changes no wire/API bytes, and approximately halves scratch. It does not clear the exact-Leopard-main gate: the target full-output cell remains 2.32% slower. Keep this as an intermediate composable optimization while the parent GF16 encoder gap remains open; broader K/R/length dispatch remains deliberately unpromoted.
